item.title: Kurin: a place, a collaboration, a community
item.description: The story of building Kurin in Balyki, with construction and finished photographs, Mykola’s craft, and what finishing the place came to mean during the war. The project began in 2021; this is an addition to the archive today.

item.title: Making a home in Kyiv
item.description: The apartment story and photographs: finding a home after years of moving, obsessing over the bathroom, and learning how I wanted to live. An older project brought into this growing archive.
